recommendations.summary: The gold border close-up on Instagram reached the most people and earned the highest engagement rate so far, with more saves and messages than the earlier festive evenings post. With only three posts that differ in creative, platform and posting date, we cannot tell which change caused the difference.

next_campaign.change: show the same teal silk saree in a full festive-evening drape instead of the gold border close-up, keeping platform and organic kind the same
next_campaign.brief: Celebrate the craft behind our teal silk saree with its wide gold border, draped softly for festive evenings, and Message us on Instagram or Facebook if you would like to know more.

advice.summary: SAMPLE advice from the made-up demo numbers. Instagram close-ups are bringing free reach, saves and new followers, while posting on both apps the same day splits attention.

signals.fact: r1 and r2 went out on the same day, so they competed for the same people's attention
no post has been boosted, so all reach so far is free reach

actions.hindi: फेसबुक और इंस्टाग्राम पर एक ही दिन पोस्ट न करें। इस हफ्ते एक दिन इंस्टाग्राम पर फोटो डालें और अगले दिन फेसबुक पर डालें।
actions.english: Do not post on Facebook and Instagram on the same day. This week share a photo on Instagram on one day and on Facebook on the next day.
actions.why: r1 and r2 were posted together and competed for the same attention, so giving each post its own day helps each reach more of the right people.

actions.hindi: इंस्टाग्राम पर रोज कमेंट और मैसेज का जवाब दें। नए फॉलो करने वालों को धन्यवाद का मैसेज भेजें और पूछें कि उन्हें कौन सा रंग पसंद है।
actions.english: On Instagram, reply to comments and messages every day. Send a thank you message to new followers and ask which colour they like.
actions.why: new followers are coming from your posts, and a quick personal reply helps turn profile visits into messages.

actions.hindi: इस हफ्ते इंस्टाग्राम पर साड़ी के बॉर्डर और कपड़े की दो क्लोज-अप फोटो डालें। कैप्शन में लोगों से कहें कि पसंद आए तो सेव करें और मैसेज करें।
actions.english: This week share two close-up photos of the saree border and fabric on Instagram. In the caption ask people to save the post and message you if they like it.
actions.why: all reach so far is free, and close-ups earned the most saves, so more detail photos can grow free reach without paying.
